description: This file defines a REST controller for managing desktop icons within sessions in a backend application. It handles creating, listing, updating, and deleting icons through HTTP endpoints.

classes.name: DesktopIconController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for managing desktop icons within a session.

methods.name: DesktopIconController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the controller with the icon service.

methods.name: listIcons
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all icons for a session.

methods.name: createIcon
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new icon in a session.

methods.name: updateIcon
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing icon.

methods.name: deleteIcon
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an icon from a session.
